query: SELECT a.title, a.description, a.age, a.decade, a.sageEnrichment, a.esf FROM achievements a WHERE a.clientId = 1149902 AND a.decade IN ('teens','twenties','thirties','forties','fifties','sixties_plus') ORDER BY a.decade, a.age ASC LIMIT 20;
command: mysql --batch --raw --column-names --default-character-set=utf8mb4 --host gateway03.us-east-1.prod.aws.tidbcloud.com --port 4000 --user 32u3a1hNYuu9Gj3.7d2282893346 --database kFbbE6kqNApXGDFpQJUGV7 --execute SELECT a.title, a.description, a.age, a.decade, a.sageEnrichment, a.esf FROM achievements a WHERE a.clientId = 1149902 AND a.decade IN ('teens','twenties','thirties','forties','fifties','sixties_plus') ORDER BY a.decade, a.age ASC LIMIT 20;

rows.title: [Late (12-18)] Settling into new school
rows.description: Self-confident and cheerful, excited to be there and learn the ropes in a new place
rows.sageEnrichment: Covered in Sage session summary: Amanda demonstrates a consistent drive to identify structural problems and redesign them into logical, coherent solutions. Language and communication are central — she thinks out loud, values intellectual stimulation and the company of equals, and finds deep satisfaction in being understood. She is energised by independence and setting her own agenda, and finds fulfilment in seeing tangible real-world impact from her work.

rows.title: [Late (12-18)] Reading and learning
rows.description: figuring out who I was and where I fitted into the hierarchy of society, absorbing academic and social knowledge
rows.sageEnrichment: Covered in Sage session summary: Amanda demonstrates a consistent drive to identify structural problems and redesign them into logical, coherent solutions. Language and communication are central — she thinks out loud, values intellectual stimulation and the company of equals, and finds deep satisfaction in being understood. She is energised by independence and setting her own agenda, and finds fulfilment in seeing tangible real-world impact from her work.

rows.title: [Late (12-18)] head girl
rows.description: liked being in charge, liked the responsibility, enjoyed the public speaking aspects
rows.sageEnrichment: What she found fulfilling was the ability to organize and improve things; while she had rules to follow, she was trusted to apply them in ways that made sense to her or to alter the rules if she could persuade teachers her changes were logical. Rather than seeking power, she valued the ability to change things rather than having to abide by illogical rules imposed by others.

rows.title: working
rows.description: learning about the world of work, and also adulthood
rows.sageEnrichment: Covered in Sage session summary: Amanda demonstrates a consistent drive to identify structural problems and redesign them into logical, coherent solutions. Language and communication are central — she thinks out loud, values intellectual stimulation and the company of equals, and finds deep satisfaction in being understood. She is energised by independence and setting her own agenda, and finds fulfilment in seeing tangible real-world impact from her work.

rows.title: Travelling and absorbing knowledge
rows.description: Travelling though south america, learning italian
rows.sageEnrichment: She had studied South American literature at school which was geographically grounded, did extensive research about where she wanted to visit, and was able to set her own agenda entirely independently, using her school Spanish to communicate and then applying it to learn Italian as a similar language.

rows.title: University
rows.description: understanding where I fitted into the social and academic hierarchy at university
rows.sageEnrichment: Unlike school with its strict timetables and supervised tasks, university's freedom required her to mindfully balance social life, work, sport, food, and sleep with a new group of high-achieving individuals. She found herself navigating ambiguity to figure out where the intellectual level was and where she fit in, along with everyone else thrown into the deep end. Once she found her intellectual equals who were also supportive and warm company, it became a time of interesting and stimulating conversations.

rows.title: studying
rows.description: working really hard at academic studies and really enjoying it, but not achieving top marks
rows.sageEnrichment: Covered in Sage session summary: Amanda demonstrates a consistent drive to identify structural problems and redesign them into logical, coherent solutions. Language and communication are central — she thinks out loud, values intellectual stimulation and the company of equals, and finds deep satisfaction in being understood. She is energised by independence and setting her own agenda, and finds fulfilment in seeing tangible real-world impact from her work.

rows.title: experimenting with different areas of work
rows.description: wanting to learn new skills and better use of existing skills that the bar didnt value
rows.sageEnrichment: She found the bar very academic, solo, not creative or sociable, and wanted to be more proactive. She experimented by trying to fashion solutions to problems she encountered in her own life that weren't being solved: Apartfrom helped young professionals make better use of their limited leisure time, while funditfrog helped new parents find what they needed whilst also donating to charity.

rows.title: Entrepreneurship
rows.description: starting to want more freedom and a broader interaction with the world of work
rows.sageEnrichment: Covered in Sage session summary: Amanda demonstrates a consistent drive to identify structural problems and redesign them into logical, coherent solutions. Language and communication are central — she thinks out loud, values intellectual stimulation and the company of equals, and finds deep satisfaction in being understood. She is energised by independence and setting her own agenda, and finds fulfilment in seeing tangible real-world impact from her work.

rows.title: settling romantically
rows.description: NULL
rows.sageEnrichment: She had had a number of quite long-term relationships and was in no hurry to settle down permanently, but the man who became her husband was adamant they should marry and have a family. Although he can be difficult, he is never boring, and she could see herself raising a family with him without getting bored or bogged down. She recognized that accepting the sacrifices and constraints brought rewards that couldn't be achieved otherwise, and she maintained intellectual independence by starting businesses alongside her domestic responsibilities.

rows.title: love of learning
rows.description: still looking for what I could really excel at but also settling into life outside work
rows.sageEnrichment: Covered in Sage session summary: Amanda demonstrates a consistent drive to identify structural problems and redesign them into logical, coherent solutions. Language and communication are central — she thinks out loud, values intellectual stimulation and the company of equals, and finds deep satisfaction in being understood. She is energised by independence and setting her own agenda, and finds fulfilment in seeing tangible real-world impact from her work.

rows.title: still seeking something else
rows.description: trying things out, looking for more outlets for my creativity
rows.sageEnrichment: Covered in Sage session summary: Amanda demonstrates a consistent drive to identify structural problems and redesign them into logical, coherent solutions. Language and communication are central — she thinks out loud, values intellectual stimulation and the company of equals, and finds deep satisfaction in being understood. She is energised by independence and setting her own agenda, and finds fulfilment in seeing tangible real-world impact from her work.

rows.title: raising children
rows.description: juggling ideas with bringing up children and supporting my children
rows.sageEnrichment: Covered in Sage session summary: Amanda demonstrates a consistent drive to identify structural problems and redesign them into logical, coherent solutions. Language and communication are central — she thinks out loud, values intellectual stimulation and the company of equals, and finds deep satisfaction in being understood. She is energised by independence and setting her own agenda, and finds fulfilment in seeing tangible real-world impact from her work.

rows.title: making organisational changes within my childrens' school
rows.description: making things better, bringing people together, fixing things whilst remaining in touch with the world my children inhabited
rows.sageEnrichment: The parents running school fundraising had become an insular clique—a law unto themselves and not inclusive to new parents—resulting in little social cohesion. After being asked to get involved, she saw things that needed changing, so she set up a more formal and organized social structure and reorganized the fundraising to be much more coherent and efficiently organized, opening it up and creating coherence where there had been chaos.

rows.title: doing up houses
rows.description: creatively and organisationally satisfying to build in reality
rows.sageEnrichment: She found satisfaction in the combination of imagining solutions to practical problems (like window placement or kitchen organization) along with creative choices and decisions, all resulting in tangible outcomes achieved her own way—problem-solving made physical.

rows.title: looking after parents
rows.description: patience and coping and caring
rows.sageEnrichment: Her mother told her that when she arrived each day, their day went from black and white into colour, which made her feel the daily visits were deeply appreciated and worthwhile. Her father described her as 'the soul of competence,' and while there were logistics and new systems to institute (like rotas for external carers and hospital visits), she came to realize it was the positive energy she brought that made the real difference.

rows.title: bringing happiness and positive energy to my ill mother
rows.description: going every day to see them, helping keep my mother and father's spirits up, providing logistical help where I could
rows.sageEnrichment: Covered in Sage session summary: Amanda demonstrates a consistent drive to identify structural problems and redesign them into logical, coherent solutions. Language and communication are central — she thinks out loud, values intellectual stimulation and the company of equals, and finds deep satisfaction in being understood. She is energised by independence and setting her own agenda, and finds fulfilment in seeing tangible real-world impact from her work.

rows.title: Covid
rows.description: settling into doing less, having more constraints on my freedom and more caring responsibilities as my parents lived with us
rows.sageEnrichment: Covered in Sage session summary: Amanda demonstrates a consistent drive to identify structural problems and redesign them into logical, coherent solutions. Language and communication are central — she thinks out loud, values intellectual stimulation and the company of equals, and finds deep satisfaction in being understood. She is energised by independence and setting her own agenda, and finds fulfilment in seeing tangible real-world impact from her work.

rows.title: Developing the relationship with my children as adults
rows.description: taking time and offering guidance and advice, sharing their lives
rows.sageEnrichment: Her children are an interesting combination of her and her husband, and they have an excellent, open relationship where they are happy to discuss things and ask her advice as she used to with her own mother. She loves having insight into their lives and feeling that she can help practically or with advice in small ways, being invited into that role of offering structure and guidance rather than imposing it.
